name: Tidio
oneLiner: Customer service platform for small and midsize businesses combining live chat, the Lyro AI agent, Flows automation and a help desk.
bestFor: Small and midsize businesses, including restaurants, that want a website chat widget with an AI agent and no coding.

updates.text: Tidio reported that Lyro ranked first in the default view of G2's AI CX Agent Evaluations (as of October 7, 2026): it passed 40 of 46 tasks and tied for the top overall score among nine agents, with the highest policy-compliance score (92%).
Lyro extended to email ticketing (Tidio product news; no date confirmed, not used in review).

features: Live chat widget for websites with mobile and desktop apps for agents
Lyro AI agent that answers questions from your knowledge base and website
Lyro handoff to a human agent
Flows: visual no-code automation for greetings, lead capture and FAQs
Help desk ticketing for email, with Lyro on email tickets
Integrations with Instagram, Messenger and WhatsApp
Analytics on conversations and AI resolutions

pricing.text: Free plan ($0: 50 billable conversations a month, 10 seats, 50 Lyro AI conversations for life). Starter $24.17 per month (100 billable conversations); Growth from $49.17 per month (from 250 billable conversations); Plus from $300 per month plus usage; Premium on request (from 3,000 Lyro conversations). Lyro AI Agent add-on from $32.50 per month for 50 Lyro conversations; Flows add-on from $24.17 per month. 7-day free trial of Starter, Growth, Lyro and Flows, no credit card. Annual billing gives 2 months free; the prices shown are the annual ones ($24.17 is $29 x 10/12).

notes: tidio.com could not be fetched from this session; prices come from search snippets of tidio.com/pricing and 2026 pricing guides. Original's '$24/month' updated to $24.17 annually. The G2 ranking is reported by Tidio itself. Messaging integrations (Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp) not re-verified and kept out of the review. 2026-11: tidio.com/pricing was opened directly; plan prices and limits above come from it. The page shows a Monthly / Annually (2 months free) toggle without labeling the displayed prices; $24.17 and $49.17 match $29 and $59 with 2 months free, and 2026 guides call them annual prices. G2 rating (4.6, 1,879 reviews) from a G2 comparison page snippet; g2.com returned 403. The G2 Evaluations post (October 7, 2026) was opened directly.
pros: Free plan with live chat, 10 seats and 50 lifetime Lyro conversations
Lyro answers from your website and knowledge base and hands chats to a person
No-code Flows for greetings, lead capture and FAQs
Starter at $24.17 per month, billed annually
Lyro ranked first in the default view of G2's AI CX Agent Evaluations (as reported by Tidio, October 2026), with 92% policy compliance

cons.text: Lyro beyond the first 50 conversations is a paid add-on, from $32.50 a month for 50 Lyro conversations
Plans are capped by billable conversations: 50 a month on Free and 100 on Starter
Flows reaches 100 visitors a month on the Free and Starter plans; more needs the Flows add-on
Built for small and midsize businesses; larger teams move to Plus (from $300 a month plus usage) or Premium on request

plans.trial: 7-day free trial of Starter, Growth, Lyro and Flows; no credit card
plans.billing: per month, billed annually (2 months free)
